title: Infusion
text:
Infusions are a stackable buffs which can be consumed by certain spells to gain additional effects. They are generated as remnants that spawn from certain skills.


== Mechanics ==
The three main Infusions are: Fire Infusion, Cold Infusion, and Lightning Infusion. There is also a fourth type of Infusion called Verisium Infusion, which can act as any one of the other three Infusions.
Elemental Equilibrium adjusts the element type of Elemental Infusions generated.
Elemental Infusions by themselves do nothing, making increased Remnant Effect useless on them.
